<!-- pr-reviewer: 56373d4c9ef55f13497f54b3dbfdcfdbdb8f38ca -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (after #1070 lands; stacked, so this review covers only the delta over #1070's head 19084572: `setup_sheet/tools.rs`, the new test, the decision file).

**What looks good**
- Omission rules are right: `catalog_line` runs `normalized()` (blank text reads as unstated), emits fixed order PART/VENDOR/COATING/HELIX, skips unstated fields whole, and returns `None` when nothing is stated, so no line is printed (`tools.rs` catalog_line).
- Existing output is unchanged for tools without catalog fields: the new line is only pushed inside `if let Some(..)`. The existing byte-identical and every-float suites pass.
- Helix goes through `mm()`, so non-finite values print `n/a` and there is no scientific notation. Notes are deliberately not printed.
- The sheet is plain text only, so there is no HTML/PDF escaping to do. The short fields cannot hold control characters once stored, because `catalog_gate` in `commands/tool.rs` (#1070) refuses them on create and change.
- The test pins the stated, unstated and omitted-coating cases, and checks that notes and "None" never appear.

**Local results** (merged with current upstream/main, clean merge, no build.rs/.github/scripts/deps touched)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test setup_sheet`: 8 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- A project file edited by hand or loaded from disk may bypass `catalog_gate`. A newline in a vendor string would then split the sheet's line. Consider having `catalog_line` replace control characters with a space, or confirm project load re-validates. This is cosmetic: the sheet is display only.
- The PR body says "Retarget/merge main after #1070 lands". Its base is already `main`, so the diff shows #1070's commits until then.
- No snapshot PNG, CHANGELOG or process-file changes. The `Changelog:`, `Effort:` and `Fixes #1063` lines are present.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 3359e65607e0676c61040668955af21a53f94012 -->
**Needs changes before merge** - one small build break once merged with current main; everything else looks right.

**Real scope.** This branch carries both #898 (tool model fields, project file, `AddTool`/`ChangeTool` gate, editor rows, MCP `add_tool` definition) and #1063 (the sheet line). #1070 (#898's PR) is still open, so this PR lands #898 too. The body says "stacked on #1070" and only `Fixes #1063`, which matches the PR title, but merging this closes the work #1070 owns; the maintainer should merge one or the other first (merging #1070 first leaves this PR as the 29-line sheet change).

**What looks good**
- Stamp and output isolation: `operation/stamp_tool.rs` digests named numeric fields only, and the catalog is not among them, so no saved operation goes stale. `catalog` is read nowhere in generators or posts.
- Golden / recorded-stream / `solid_law_goldens` / `golden_cl` / `mill2d_*` / `operations` / motion test changes are all one line, `catalog: ToolCatalog::default()` in a `Tool { .. }` literal. No golden text and no recorded stream moved. The same holds for `drilling/tests.rs` and `center_cut_owed.rs`: fixture construction only.
- Project file: five optional keys, `skip_serializing_if` so an unstated tool saves byte for byte as before; round-trip, old-JSON and tool-library tests in `tool_catalog_fields.rs`; no version bump needed.
- Edits go through `AddTool::new` and `ChangeTool::judged` (`commands/tool.rs`, `catalog_gate`), trimmed and refused by tool name at creation: 80/500 character caps, control characters refused (newline allowed in notes only), helix 0..=90 and finite. One-step undo/redo is pinned. `Tool::sane` also checks it, so a hand-edited file with a bad helix is refused naming the tool. MCP `add_tool` takes the same keys through the same DTO; no edit tool exists, and the decision note files that.
- The sheet prints `PART / VENDOR / COATING / HELIX n deg` in a fixed order, omits empty facts, prints no line for a tool with none, and never prints notes. Plain sheet text only; nothing reaches posted G-code or a comment. The `)`/`;` characters are therefore not a concern here (if a field is ever posted as a comment, that needs its own sanitiser).
- Layering is fine (ui uses `camcraft_app::catalog_fields`); the new file is 56 lines with a provenance line; `pages.rs` grows by one line; `state.rs` by 31; no snapshot PNG; no build.rs, scripts, `.github` or dependency changes; no non-test `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!`.

**Local results (trial-merged with origin/main 53a52f88; the merge itself is clean, no conflicts)**
- `camcraft-app` test build FAILS on the merged tree:
```
error[E0063]: missing field `catalog` in initializer of `Tool`
 crates/app/tests/hole_wall_flats.rs:~70  (test "hole_wall_flats")
```
- With that one line added locally (not pushed), everything below is green: camcraft-tools lib 70 + tests 3; app `setup_sheet` 8, `tool_catalog_fields` 7, `project_roundtrip` 71, `golden_cl` 26, `recorded_post_streams` 2, `solid_law_goldens` 5, `mill2d_b` 9, `mill2d_c` 9, `operations` 117 (6 ignored), `mcp` 18; motion `drilling` unit tests 34, `center_cut_owed` 7; camcraft-ui lib (from `crates/ui`) 617 (5 ignored); `cargo clippy -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/app/tests/hole_wall_flats.rs` (the `Tool { .. }` literal near line 83, added on main after this branch forked): add `catalog: camcraft_tools::catalog_fields::ToolCatalog::default(),`. Merge main into the branch and add it, so main does not go red when this lands. (A cheaper long-term fix, not required here: the literal-heavy test fixtures keep breaking on new `Tool` fields; a `Tool::default`-style helper would stop that.)

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `pub mod catalog_fields;` in `crates/tools/src/lib.rs` and the `pub use` in `app/src/lib.rs` sit out of the file's alphabetical/commented order; cosmetic.
- `state.rs` (4390 lines) and `pages.rs` (1757 lines) are far over ~400 and grew slightly; the new rows were correctly put in their own file.
- Changelog line is present; `Effort: medium` is fine for the display part, but #898's tool model/file/command work in the same diff touches the project format, so the maintainer may prefer #1070 merge first as it is.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
